The first also enumerates all smaller sets. The monotonic propagation recurrence matches the mathematical definition by induction; the output is a finite exhaustive proof, not inference from random tests.

value.rationale: A sharp optimal placement number and complete latency-by-induced-edge spectrum are natural, as opposed to ad hoc selected statistics, for the unique 50-vertex degree-seven Moore graph. This canonical high-symmetry benchmark permits independent exhaustive verification and calibrates computational power-domination methods: of 15,890,700 six-sets only 2,329,950 are feasible, no five-set succeeds, and no optimal placement induces three or more edges. The precise round distribution distinguishes equally optimal installations by observation delay; it is neither an automatic textbook deduction nor a known published table in accessible sources.
